name: Regency Fincorp Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Regency Fincorp Ltd is in the business of a Non-Banking Financial Institution. [1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
RFL is a non-deposit, non-systemically important NBFC registered with the RBI. It provides customer-centric financial services, mainly in the form of micro-credit, to the underserved and unserved women population and MSMEs of the country.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 69.5% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 6.49% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -7.40%
